en.title: Colin Kaepernick says NFL owners are colluding against Macklemore after Ed Sheeran tour ban
en.summary: Colin Kaepernick has accused NFL owners of colluding against rapper Macklemore following his removal from Ed Sheeran's tour due to pro-Palestine remarks. Kaepernick, whose NFL career was affected by his own protests against police violence, draws parallels between his situation and Macklemore's.
